topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Found a time capsule this morning, down in the basement of an old building I'm supposed to tear down. Should've been just another day, another wrecking ball. But there it was, sealed up tight, stamped with a date thirty years back. Problem is, this place was empty for the last two decades, according to the records. Somebody slipped it in, maybe as a joke, or maybe they had something to hide. Doesn't matter now; it's my problem. I'll need to figure out what's inside before I can decide if I should open it or bury it deeper.
